status: Patterns follow Claude Code's stream-json output: each assistant event wraps one content block, tool calls are tool_use blocks with name and input, and the final result event carries total_cost_usd and num_turns. Re-check on the smoke run after Claude Code updates.
usage: Per arm: --env CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<arm>/claude and credentials (--env CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=... or --env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...). Plugin variant: --append-arg --plugin-dir --append-arg <dir>. Pin the model for both arms: --append-arg --model --append-arg <model>. Do not add --include-partial-messages: every tool call would be counted twice. skill:<id> sees model-initiated loads (the Skill tool), not slash-command invocations.
